<function name="Read" parent="File" type="classfunc">
	<args>
		<arg name="length" type="number" default="nil">Reads the specified amount of chars. If not set, will read the entire file.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="data" type="string">The read data.</ret>
	</rets>
	<description>Reads the specified amount of chars and returns them as a binary string.</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Adapted from extensions/file.lua</description>
	<code>
function file.Read( filename, path )

	if ( path == true ) then path = "GAME" end
	if ( path == nil || path == false ) then path = "DATA" end

	local f = file.Open( filename, "rb", path )
	if ( !f ) then return end

	local str = f:Read( f:Size() )

	f:Close()

	if ( !str ) then str = "" end
	return str

end
	</code>
</example>
